scriptData.label: Add granted Talents, Traits and items

description.label: Description
description.value:
Major Physical Mutation

You grow a protective layer on your entire body. Roll on the @Table[protective-skin] table to determine what kind. If parts of your body already have been gifted with some sort of fur or hide you may choose if you want this mutation to override that or not. This armour doesn't stack with other natural armour unless it's Flexible. You can only gain this mutation once.
